en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European industrial town in a river valley, with tree‑lined streets, multi‑story masonry apartment blocks, rail or tram tracks along the foreground, and a prominent neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire on the right. In the mid‑ground are factories with smokestacks, and in the background terraced hills and a fortress or large building on a hilltop. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century postcard photograph.
